schema_extensions.tool.apmx: max axial depth of cut (in) printed in the catalog for the part; null if not published
schema_extensions.tool.programming_radius: vendor's 'theoretical radius' / defined radius rp for CAM programming (in); tool.corner_radius is null because the vendor publishes no separate corner radius
schema_extensions.tool.max_ramp_deg: max ramp angle, null where unpublished
schema_extensions.cut.ap_min / cut.ap_max: when the vendor gives a range of axial depth, ap is the upper bound and ap_min the lower bound (in)
schema_extensions.cut.ae_min_over_D: when the vendor gives a minimum radial engagement ('>= .65 x Dia'), ae is that minimum and cut.ae_is_minimum is true
schema_extensions.cut.vf_ipm / cut.rpm: published feed rate and rpm where the vendor prints them
schema_extensions.tool.DCX_mm / DC_at_apmx_mm / APMXS_mm /: Seco catalog values in mm as printed (DCX = max cutting diameter = tool.DC; Seco's DC is the diameter at APMXS); tool.DC, apmx, corner_radius (RE), programming_radius (RP), neck_diameter (DN) and LB (LN) are their inch conversions
schema_extensions.tool.psir_deg_printed: the catalog's PSIR column as printed (JHF980 -5.0, SHF712 1.5); NOT used as the lead angle (lead_angle_deg stays null)

material.vendor_label: P2 Low-alloy ferritic steels, C < 0.25 %wt / low-alloy weldable general structural steels (320 < Rm < 600 N/mm2; reference S235JRG2, Rm 420)

vendor_notes: SMG = Seco material group; vc in m/min (sf/min); fz = mm (in/tooth); ap and ae are factors of DCX; coolant A=air D=dry E=emulsion M=mist spray
All cutting data are target values
For cutting data recalculations, see pages 732 - 740 (catalog printed page numbers)
rows.notes: Item 980015-MEGA (02511199, length index 2, the shortest-reach item of this DCX and flute count). Catalog DCX 1.5 mm = DC 0.05906 in; Seco's printed DC (0.75 mm) is the diameter at APMXS and is kept in tool.DC_at_apmx_mm. ap = ap/DCX x DCX = 0.04 x 1.5 mm = 0.0600 mm = 0.00236 in (below APMXS 0.1 mm = 0.00394 in). Slot: ae = DCX. Numeric fz (in/tooth) and sf/min with its range are the printed inch line; the metric line (fz mm, vc m/min) is in source.cells and cut.published. Seco prints inch values rounded (fz 0.046 mm / 25.4 = 0.00181, vc 330 m/min x 3.2808 = 1083 sf/min). Cutting-data page is the series' table for every flute count of the DCX; fz is per tooth. JHF980: printed PSIR -5.0 kept in tool.psir_deg_printed, not used as the lead angle. 'All cutting data are target values'.
